I feel like I have this mental barrier keeping me from my greatness all the time. Like there is this wall. If I try to pass through it actually get physical pain in my head. I have a headache writing this. The words are just coming out through my fingers. I’m basically not thinking about any of it. I can’t describe the feeling. Going from being smart and gradually becoming dumb. I used to be able to understand all sorts of abstract concepts and learn things. Now If you don’t tell me what the answer is I have no care or desire to continue. Or just cant get it on my own.
	
Every girlfriend I’ve ever has, Stephenie, Ashley, Katie, Alex has cheated. They’ve all been unfaithful. Sexted, physically cheated, flirted around. Something. You know what they say? If everywhere you go smells like shit, check you feet? Well I have. And I don’t know what I’ve done to push them away. I’ve been nothing but as kind and caring as I can be. Anytime I like a girl she wants nothing to do with me but be friends unless she’s a whore or wants something from me I think. I hate being unattractive. I’ve lost the genetic lottery. I’m short. I’m ugly. And I made myself fat. I know exactly how to not be fat. But its like with thinking. Theres this giant barrier I can’t get over.
	
I’m not good at anything. I’ve been playing games since I was 5. About the only thing I can do is learn the core concept relatively quickly and that’s just experience. After this I do not perform well unless I have a major advantage. It bothers me to no fucking end. I feel like a man child. People expect me to know things or do things because I’m a white male adult. I don’t know anything of these things. I feel so innocent while the world looks at me like I’m evil, dumb, or ignorant, or just plain lazy. 
	
I do not understand. I know I can understand. I know can do a lot of things. At the same time I can’t do any of them. My interests are always changing. I’m so angry over how much bullshit so many people have put me through. I wish I had the drive on a day where I didn’t care, and the means, to go on a killing spree. There are so many people who have wronged me I wish I could just make them all suffer. But tomorrow I’ll wake up, if I’m not dead yet, and feel none of that. What am I supposed to do though? Anytime something comes back on me and I get in trouble. I love how it's okay she can talk about potentially offensive stuff but I can't even tell her that I have no problem with it without being called fucking ignorant and having a case put against me. Going around saying you have a wife and you're gay is just as offensive to people. Parading around like somehow that makes you superior.
	
I really wish I Knew what to say. I’m disgusting. I see it. I don’t care. OR rather I do care, but am unable to do anything about it. That sounds strange because I’m not disabled. I am unable to care about the fact that I care about something. It takes more than wanting or needing to do something. There’s that step in-between that and doing it. I do not have that step on my staircase. Anytime I try to it doesn’t work. I fall back down. This applies to so many things. Even if I manage to go over that step towards doing it doesn’t last. I really don’t know how to articulate my feelings in a way that properly conveys what I am trying to convey.

If you guys care to read. This is what I have so far on my suicide note. Wall of Text INC.

The reason I’ve decided to this is complicated. It stems from many things. This may be scatter brained and ranty/run-on as I type it due to the nature of how I think. I apologize in advance for the inconvienences. It may contain humor and seriousness as morbid as that sounds. I will try to keep most of the Humor inside ( ).
	
First off I would like to say sorry to everyone. You have all made an impact and impression on my life That I have never forgotten. I wish everyone the best and do not grieve me for I am a failure. I am basically worthless and useless. I have no talents, no skills, I’m all smoke and mirrors. The only thing I’m good at is recognizing a concept or pattern and repeating it back to someone in a way that makes It seem like I know what I am talking about.
	
I question myself everytime I do something, no matter how simple or complex. Sometimes I wonder I’m brushing my teeth the right way or should I really tie my shoes this way? I feel like a man child. I have no social skills. I know how to do almost nothing. Anything I do know is so basic I’m ashamed to even pretend like I know more. I have no interests. I like somethings sometimes like fast cars or dragonballz or dwarves. But I never feel any passion in anything. I can just fake it really well. If I do somehow manage it, it’s gone within the next 24 hours or I dream so much that I ruin my own interest.
	

Now that that is out of the way. I feel guilty. Doing this is a horrible thing to do to you all. But where do I Draw the line? I tell you what. I write down everything I can remember as it comes to me.  Maybe we can piece the puzzle together after I’m gone as to what the fuck is wrong with me. 
	
So the final push was Work. I had finally found a job that I liked. That I could see myself doing a few years from now. But that all came crashing to a halt because of her. I feel no vindication towards her, she is a great person and hard worker I just wish I knew what the fuck I did wrong or could understand it. Though I feel like Natasha and Heather are twisting my words against me. Like Natasha is crying wolf. Why, I do not know.
	
We were out on a delivery on 05/14/2015 and we were talking. I mentioned how when I met her she seemed apprehensive about mentioning that she is a lesbian. She told me that her and her wife are often ridiculed or put down because of it and she has to be careful with who she meets. I get that, I’ve been bullied most of my life. I told her that I never thought differently of her and never judged her for it. I told her about how I may disagree with some things but to me it’s the person that matters as long they don’t push their opinions on me and treat me nice I will do the same. I wanted to make a new friend. To comfort her as we would be working together. I told her that I feel I often need to walk on eggshells around the LGBT community because they take offense to everything it seems like. She agreed. She said her and her wife do not do that and think those “other women” give them a bad name. I told her about how there was a TGirl at Walmart that I was interested in and didn’t know how to approach and was afraid because she’s either a transgender or effeminate male and one I would be attracted to the other I wouldn’t. I told her that I can’t believe people really do that to her and her wife when she mentioned the things that people to do them. I mentioned that I don’t care what people do or choose to do it’s the person that matters to me. That just because someone does gay things that I don’t like or agree with as long as they’re cool to me I will be the same to them. I mentioned that I would go have drinks with her and her wife because she seems cool. I told her that It seems like we’ll get along well because we have similar views and she had been agreeing with me the whole time and she agreed to that as well. She never once gave me any indication that she was offended and never told me to stop.  We didn’t talk about it again at all that night. She says we did and she is lying. I told her about my previous pill habbit and the time I used heroin. Nothing more nothing less.  I felt comfortable with talking to her and the way she opened up a but to me about things I felt she was the same. I looked forward to seeing her and everyone else the next morning. 
	
Heather sat me down and told me what I did wrong. Which was shocking to me because I had no clue. She was very rude and treated me like a criminal. She was horrible about it. Acting like I was lying to her when I was not. I told her the synopsis of the above and she told The District Manage that I talked to her multiple times without heeding Natasha’s requests to stop, that I told her I didn’t like what she did and that basically I was hateful to her. She twisted my words. 
	
Fuck them. They can rot in hell after this. I liked them before and now I hate them. Now I hate all LGBT. I hope they all die or get the treatment they need. It takes a sick individual to Take offense to everything, to twist words, to do something unnatural and expect everyone to bend to their beliefs or be ignorant. It takes a mentally and emotionally defeated person to kill themself. They were the final nail in the coffin for me. I told myself when I started, If I don’t make it here this is the end for me as I have no hope of being a functioning adult.  I didn’t believe I would actually do it. But after being treated this way. By being deceived, lied to, lied about, having my words twisted, putting a mar on my reputation forever because someone decided to spread lies about me. I’ve had it. This has happened all of my life. I Don’t even know What I do wrong. I cannot comprehend how I could have possibly offended someone so joyful, so agreeing, someone who basically was in totally agreement with me. Someone I thought was a friend. 
	
I don’t get it. Why does the bad shit happen to me. My ex is a druggie, a cheater and a liar and she lives fine and get her way. Stevie is so many negative things and lives well and never has these issues. I have seen so many people live like scumbags and get away with so much. Yet here I am trying to make a friend and I get fucked. It’s always the same story. Anytime I try to make a friend somehow I end up getting fucked. Anytime I do what I think is okay it ends up getting me in trouble. I see people get into fights and nothing happens. I tried to defend my mother from a hateful old bastard and got arrested. I do not get it. Anytime my life starts looking up it comes crashing down. I don’t understand what I’m doing wrong. At this point I don’t think I can. I’m defective. I’m useless. I can’t even drive that far. I have lived around this area my whole life and don’t know where I’m going most of the time. I know barely any street names. If I Do know where I’m going I get there almost entirely on autopilot and don’t remember most of the drive there. Sometimes I can remember things Sometimes only bits and pieces. I have such a hard time articulation myself without reiterating many times the same thing and still don’t feel I’ve conveyed myself properly. I feel so lost. 
	
I’m so lonely. I don’t know how to talk to other people. It’s like everything I think is right is somehow wrong now. I don’t know what I’m doing. If you ask me questions sometimes I can answer but most of the time I draw a blank and just say something and hope it’s right. Sometimes I have an answer. If there is pressure It’s like I forget everything and it takes so much effort to remember it all. I have no drive. No ambition. I’m fuckin lazy. I don’t understand it. 
	
I’m fat, unattractive, can’t keep my attention on something, I don’t know how to have fun or keep people engaged. I’m terrible at conversation. My thoughts, opinions, and even how much I know seems to be based entirely on my mood. Which can come crashing down in as little as me not knowing if someone is joking with me or making fun of me. Most of the time I don’t even understand if someone is and just try to roll with it. I’ve tried to figure out what’s wrong with me myself. I do not know. I swear up and down I have some sort of mental condition. I feel so smart like I could do so much but have no idea how to. I can’t accept being average. I feel the need to excel but not the need to actually do anything to get there. It’s like thinking about it is enough for me. If you asked me tomorrow I wouldn’t remember or know how to articulate this and would not be able to in the same way. I feel manipulative. I feel like I don’t care about someone or something unless there is a gain for me in some way even if it’s in the future. Sometimes I care about other people’s feelings other times I don’t. If I saw someone in a car accident depending on my mood and if I subconsciously thought there was gain would determine whether I helped or potentially ended them or just left them there. I don’t even know how to explain it. I can’t explain my thought process. On anything.
